title: Oven Roasted Turkish Masarepa Flatbread
description: A crisp, cultured flatbread made with corn masarepa flour and flavored with lemon zest and spices, perfect for a post‑workout boost.
instructions: In a bowl mix masarepa flour, sea salt, cumin, oregano, and nutritional yeast.
Add water and olive oil, stirring until a sticky dough forms.
Divide the dough into four equal portions and roll each into a thin circle.
Place the circles on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, drizzle a thin layer of olive oil, and return to the oven for 5 minutes to crisp the edges.
Let the flatbreads cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for extra brightness.
